title: Kari Trestakk
world: Present-day Norway. Kari's father, the king, lives in a palace of glass and concrete at the end of a long avenue of trees, half home and half offices, with garages, a staff car park and a red barn for the royal cows, which graze on the mountain behind. The blue-grey ox keeps a small, folded white cloth in his left ear; spread on the grass, it sets itself with food. Far beyond the last motorways, power lines and paths lie three magic forests: one of copper, one of silver with leaves as thin as razor blades, and one of gold that drips from the leaves. Each troll wears a curved cow horn of healing salve at its belt. At the journey's end, a dark cliff on a windswept plateau looks down on another kingdom's castle with towers and an old stone church. The gold shoes are small, pointed and shining.
palette: Crisp early autumn: high, pale-blue skies over grey concrete and glass, yellowing birches and purple heather on the windswept plateau, with the ox's glossy blue-grey as the strongest colour until the forests blaze in copper, frost-silver and molten gold. The castle kitchen lies under flat fluorescent light; the church Sundays are bright and windy.

cast.name: Kari
cast.description: Kongsdattera som stemora tar mobilen og maten fra og setter til å gjete kyrne, og som får en god venn i den blågrå oksen.
cast.look: A slender young woman of about nineteen with a fine-boned face, high cheekbones, a slim nose, wide-set hazel eyes under straight dark-copper brows, a dimple in her chin, fair skin and long, wavy copper hair tied back loosely with a strip of blue cloth. She wears a faded green work jacket over a sage-green hoodie, worn jeans, black rubber boots and a grey knitted scarf, and carries a battered old steel thermos.
cast.portrait: Background: a forest pasture behind the glass palace, with grazing cows.

cast.name: Kari Trestakk
cast.description: En kongsdatter som stemora setter til å gjete kyr, og som rømmer med den blågrå oksen og tar oppvaskjobb på et fremmed slott i en trestakk av bord og filler.
cast.look: A slender young woman of about nineteen with a fine-boned face, high cheekbones, a slim nose, wide-set hazel eyes under straight dark-copper brows and a dimple in her chin, her face and hands black with soot and her long, wavy copper hair in a messy braid. Over her green work jacket and jeans she wears the trestakk: a stiff, bell-shaped shell of thin, grey-brown wooden boards laced together with rope and rags, reaching from her neck to her shins, and black rubber boots.
cast.portrait: Background: the steamy castle kitchen with steel counters.

cast.name: Kari i kobberkjolen
cast.description: Kari den første søndagen, i en enkel kjole som skinner som kobberskogen, med hansker og hest fra mannen i berget.
cast.look: A slender young woman of about nineteen with a fine-boned face, high cheekbones, a slim nose, wide-set hazel eyes under straight dark-copper brows, a dimple in her chin, fair skin and long, wavy copper hair falling loose down her back. She wears a long, simply cut gown of shining copper silk that glows warm orange-pink like polished copper, long copper-coloured gloves and soft copper ballet flats.

cast.name: Kari i sølvkjolen
cast.description: Kari den andre søndagen, i en kjole sydd med sølvtråd over det hele, på en hest med sølvbrodert dekken.
cast.look: A slender young woman of about nineteen with a fine-boned face, high cheekbones, a slim nose, wide-set hazel eyes under straight dark-copper brows, a dimple in her chin, fair skin and long, wavy copper hair in one loose braid woven with a silver ribbon. She wears a long, slim gown embroidered all over with silver thread that glitters like frost, a short silver-grey riding jacket and silver ankle boots, and carries a slim riding whip with a silver handle.
cast.portrait: Background: the silver forest with razor-thin leaves.

cast.name: Kari i gullkjolen
cast.description: Kari den tredje søndagen, i en kjole av nesten bare gull, besatt med klare steiner som glitrer som is, og med små sko av gull.
cast.look: A slender young woman of about nineteen with a fine-boned face, high cheekbones, a slim nose, wide-set hazel eyes under straight dark-copper brows, a dimple in her chin, fair skin and long, wavy copper hair flowing loose, held back by a slender gold band. She wears a long, full gown of gold cloth set all over with small clear stones that glitter like ice, and two small, pointed shoes of shining gold.
cast.portrait: Background: the golden forest, where gold drips from the leaves.

cast.name: Den blågrå oksen
cast.description: En stor okse som alltid er blank og ren uansett vær, som kan snakke, har en matduk i venstre øre og slåss mot trollene i skogene av kobber, sølv og gull for Kari.
cast.look: A huge, gentle ox, taller at the shoulder than a grown man, with a glossy, spotless blue-grey coat that stays clean and shining in any weather, a paler grey muzzle, big, soft dark-brown eyes with long lashes, two long, smooth cream-white horns curving upwards, large soft ears, a curly tuft of darker blue-grey hair between the horns, a long tail ending in a navy-blue tassel and dark grey hooves. Calm, kind and very strong.
cast.portrait: Background: the royal pasture on the mountain behind the palace.

cast.name: Stemora
cast.description: Kongens nye dronning, som smiler til alle og mener det med ingen, tar fra Kari mobilen og maten og betaler privatlegen for å si at hun bare blir frisk av oksekjøtt.
cast.look: A tall, thin woman of about forty-five with a long, pinched face, a sharp pointed nose, narrow pale-green eyes, thin arched eyebrows, a small mouth fixed in a bright smile that never reaches her eyes, and jet-black hair scraped into a tight, sleek bun held by a spiky silver clip. She wears a stiff, high-necked slate-grey designer dress, a long black wool coat draped over her shoulders and many heavy silver rings, and holds a white handkerchief.
cast.portrait: Background: the glass-and-concrete living room of the palace.

cast.name: Stesøstera
cast.description: Dattera til stemora, akkurat så slem som Kari er snill. Hun får gullskoen på og blir pyntet til brud.
cast.look: A gangly young woman of about twenty with a long, sour face, a pinched, turned-up nose, small squinting pale-green eyes, a pouting mouth and thin, straw-pale hair in two stiff braids that stick out sideways. She wears a frilly blouse the sour green of unripe gooseberries, covered in pink bows, a short pleated green skirt, white tights and pointed green shoes on very long, big feet.
cast.portrait: Background: a grey designer sofa in the glass palace.

cast.name: Prinsen
cast.description: En ung, ugift prins med et ansikt for forsida av et ukeblad, som tømmer vaskevannet over oppvaskjenta og så ikke kan ta øynene fra den ukjente jenta i kirka.
cast.look: A broad-shouldered young man of about twenty-five with a proud, stubborn, magazine-cover face, a strong jaw, a slightly hooked nose, bright blue eyes under straight fair brows and thick, wavy honey-blond hair swept back from his forehead and falling to his collar. He wears a slim dark-green wool suit over a heather-purple shirt with an open collar, a round gold pin on his lapel and polished black leather boots.
cast.portrait: Background: the castle with towers on a windy day.

cast.name: Mannen i berget
cast.description: En mørkkledd mann som kommer ut av bergveggen når Kari banker, med kjoler og hest til kirka og mørke, rolige øyne hun synes hun har sett før.
cast.look: A small, sturdy man of no clear age with a broad, calm face, a big round nose, big, calm dark-brown eyes with long lashes and thick, short blue-grey hair with one curly tuft at the front. He wears a long charcoal wool coat buttoned to the neck, a dark knitted jumper, dark trousers and heavy black boots, and carries a small brass lantern that glows warm yellow.
cast.portrait: Background: the dark cliff on the windswept plateau.

cast.name: Trollet med tre hoder
cast.description: Trollet som eier kobberskogen. Det har tre hoder, og alle tre er sinte når noen rører skogen.
cast.look: A squat, pot-bellied troll about twice as tall as a man, with chalk-white, lumpy skin speckled with grey freckles and patches of moss, short bandy legs and long dangling arms. It has three bald, egg-shaped heads on three thick necks, each with a big red bulbous nose, small round orange eyes, one crooked tooth and tufts of stiff orange hair behind the ears. It wears huge, ragged brown canvas work trousers held up with rope, with a curved cow horn of salve hanging from the rope.

cast.name: Trollet med ni hoder
cast.description: Trollet som eier gullskogen, sterkere enn de to andre trollene til sammen. Hver gang oksen stanger i hjel et av hodene, blåser de andre liv i det igjen.
cast.look: An enormous, pear-shaped troll as tall as a four-storey building, with lumpy, heather-pink skin, a huge round belly and short, stumpy arms and legs. Along its broad shoulders sit nine small round heads in a row, each with puffy cheeks, a tiny snub nose, small black eyes under bushy grey brows, big round ears and a shock of spiky grey hair. It wears an enormous faded brown tarpaulin tied round its middle with rope, with a curved cow horn of salve hanging from it.
cast.portrait: Background: the golden forest, where gold drips from the leaves.

places.name: the Cliff
places.look: A dark, sheer cliff rising above a big grassy mound on a high, windswept plateau of heather, juniper and grey boulders. Rusty lichen streaks the rock, and a narrow crack low in the cliff face can open like a door. From the mound there is a wide view down over a green valley to a grey stone castle with towers and an old stone church.

places.name: the Stone Church
places.look: A small, old grey stone church with a steep slate roof, a short square tower and a round-arched door inside a low stone porch, on a green hill below the castle. A dry-stone wall surrounds the churchyard, a few birches with yellowing leaves stand around it, and a gravel path leads up to the porch past a small gravel car park.

cover.prompt: On a high heather ridge at sunrise, Kari rides on the Blue-Grey Ox's back in her green work jacket, holding on to his horns, her copper hair blowing in the wind. Far behind them run a thin grey motorway and a line of pylons; far ahead, three magic forests lie one behind another in the valleys: shining copper, glittering silver and glowing gold. The ox strides forward, calm and strong, and Kari gazes at the forests in wonder.
cover.caption: Kari rir på den blågrå oksen mot skogene av kobber, sølv og gull.
cover.alt: Kari sitter på ryggen til en stor, blågrå okse på en lyngås i soloppgangen. Bak dem ligger en motorvei og kraftlinjer, foran dem tre skoger av kobber, sølv og gull.

illustrations.anchor: Så fikk kongen krig med en annen konge.
illustrations.prompt: In a vast living room of glass and concrete with a long dining table and twenty chairs, the Stepmother smiles brightly and holds out her ringed hand, and Kari, pale and unhappy, reluctantly lays her phone in it. Behind them, the Stepsister lounges on a grey designer sofa, smirking. Floor-to-ceiling windows look out on a long avenue of trees. The phone screen is dark.
illustrations.caption: Først tok hun fra Kari mobilen, så tok hun maten.
illustrations.alt: I en stor stue av glass og betong holder stemora smilende fram hånda, og Kari legger mobilen sin i den. Bak dem ligger stesøstera på sofaen og flirer.

illustrations.anchor: En kveld hadde hun drevet kyrne inn og satt seg på en stein bak garasjene
illustrations.prompt: Evening behind a row of concrete garages at the back of the palace, where a narrow service road runs into the forest. Kari, thin and pale in her green work jacket, sits on a big stone with the old steel thermos in her lap, crying. The Blue-Grey Ox has come up beside her and rests his big muzzle gently on her shoulder. Soft blue dusk and a single street lamp.
illustrations.caption: Da kom oksen og la mulen forsiktig mot skulderen hennes.
illustrations.alt: Kari sitter på en stein bak garasjene med en gammel termos i fanget og gråter. Den store, blågrå oksen legger mulen forsiktig mot skulderen hennes.

illustrations.anchor: Kari rakte hånda opp mot det store, varme øret.
illustrations.prompt: In a forest clearing on the mountain behind the palace, a white cloth lies spread on the grass, laid with steaming roast meat, fresh bread, a bowl of strawberries, a tall cream layer cake, a glass carafe of red wine and an earthenware jug of mead. Kari sits cross-legged at the cloth, surprised and delighted, with a cup of mead in her hand. The Blue-Grey Ox stands beside her, watching. Four cows graze among the birches behind.
illustrations.caption: Duken dekket på: stek, nybakt brød, jordbær, bløtkake, vin og mjød.
illustrations.alt: Kari sitter ved en hvit duk i gresset med dampende stek, nybakt brød, jordbær, bløtkake, vin og mjød. Den blågrå oksen står ved siden av og ser på.

illustrations.anchor: Hun lå på sofaen i stua med pledd over beina og gardinene trukket for
illustrations.prompt: In the dim living room of the palace with the curtains drawn, the Stepmother lies on the grey designer sofa under a soft blanket, one hand pressed dramatically to her forehead. By the door, the private doctor, a silver-haired man in a dark suit with a leather doctor's bag, slips a thick white envelope into the inside pocket of his jacket without meeting anyone's eyes.
illustrations.caption: Legen kom ut med en tykk konvolutt i innerlomma og en diagnose.
illustrations.alt: Stemora ligger på sofaen med pledd over beina og gardinene trukket for. Ved døra putter privatlegen en tykk konvolutt i innerlomma.

illustrations.anchor: Da slottet hadde sovnet, listet hun seg ut bakdøra
illustrations.prompt: Night behind the dark glass palace. In the open doorway of the red barn, the Blue-Grey Ox kneels in the straw, and Kari, in her green work jacket, climbs onto his back. Across the moonlit yard, a security camera with a small red light hangs over the garage door, and every window of the palace is dark.
illustrations.caption: Oksen knelte, hun klatret opp på ryggen hans, og så la han i vei.
illustrations.alt: Om natten klatrer Kari opp på ryggen til oksen, som ligger på kne i døra til fjøset. Over garasjeporten henger et overvåkingskamera med et lite rødt lys.

illustrations.anchor: Ved enden av skogen kom trollet.
illustrations.prompt: At the edge of a forest where every trunk, branch, leaf and flower is shining copper, the Three-Headed Troll comes stomping out between the trees in its rope-tied work trousers, all three heads scowling furiously. The Blue-Grey Ox plants his hooves and lowers his horns, and Kari, on his back, clutches a single copper leaf. Copper leaves glint in the low sun.
illustrations.caption: Det hadde tre hoder, og alle tre var sinte.
illustrations.alt: Ved enden av kobberskogen kommer et troll med tre sinte hoder ut mellom trærne. Oksen senker hornene, og Kari holder et kobberblad i hånda.

illustrations.anchor: De braste sammen.
illustrations.prompt: At dusk at the edge of the copper forest, the Blue-Grey Ox lies exhausted on the moss with his eyes half closed. Kari kneels beside him with her sleeves rolled up and rubs salve from a curved cow horn into his shoulder with a practised farm girl's hands, staring in amazement as a soft glow spreads wherever the salve touches him. The copper trees gleam dully behind them.
illustrations.caption: Kari hadde smurt kyr før, men aldri med en salve som virket mens hun så på.
illustrations.alt: Oksen ligger utslitt på mosen i skumringen. Kari kneler ved siden av ham og smører ham med salve fra et krumt kuhorn, og det lyser svakt der salven treffer.

illustrations.anchor: «Opp», sa oksen, og knelte.
illustrations.prompt: On a narrow forest track in grey morning mist, the Blue-Grey Ox, still thin and weak after the long rest, has knelt down in front of Kari and looks back at her with a patient, stubborn face. Kari stands beside him with both hands raised in protest, ready to walk. Tall, dark spruces stand all around, and a faint silver glitter shows far behind them among the trees.
illustrations.caption: «Opp», sa oksen, og knelte.
illustrations.alt: På en smal skogsti har den tynne, blågrå oksen lagt seg på kne foran Kari. Hun løfter hendene og vil heller gå selv.

illustrations.anchor: Så kom trollet med de ni hodene.
illustrations.prompt: In the golden forest, where gold drips from the leaves, the Nine-Headed Troll looms up above the treetops, as tall as a four-storey building, its nine heads glaring down in a row. The Blue-Grey Ox stands braced before it with his horns lowered. Behind him, Kari presses herself against a golden tree trunk and turns her face away, clutching a heavy golden apple in both hands. Golden light and long shadows.
illustrations.caption: Det var så fælt at Kari nesten ikke turte se på det.
illustrations.alt: Et enormt troll med ni hoder rager over trærne i gullskogen. Oksen senker hornene, og Kari snur seg bort med et gulleple i hendene.

illustrations.anchor: Til slutt kom de til en stor haug under en mørk, loddrett bergvegg.
illustrations.prompt: Wide view of a high, windswept plateau: on the big grassy mound beneath the Cliff, Kari sits on the Blue-Grey Ox's back with her hair whipping in the wind and looks down into the valley, where a grey stone castle with towers and an old stone church lie close below. The ox stands thin and tired but steady. Racing clouds, and heather bending in the wind.
illustrations.caption: Rett nedenfor lå slottet, med tårn og en gammel steinkirke like ved.
illustrations.alt: Kari sitter på oksen på en haug under en mørk bergvegg og ser ned på et slott med tårn og en gammel steinkirke.

illustrations.anchor: «Det er den eneste takken jeg vil ha», sa oksen.
illustrations.prompt: In the wind at the foot of the Cliff, Kari has flung her arms round the Blue-Grey Ox's neck and hides her face in his coat, sobbing. The ox stands quite still with his eyes closed and his great head bowed over her shoulder. A plain, straight wooden stick leans against the rock beside them, and grey evening light lies over the plateau.
illustrations.caption: «Det er den eneste takken jeg vil ha», sa oksen.
illustrations.alt: Kari har slått armene rundt halsen på oksen under bergveggen og gråter. Oksen står helt stille med lukkede øyne. En stokk står lent mot berget.

illustrations.anchor: Kjøkkensjefen skrev det på vaktlista uten å se opp.
illustrations.prompt: In a big, steamy basement kitchen with steel counters, stacked crates and flat fluorescent light, the head chef, a stout woman in chef's whites and a black cap, jots on a clipboard without looking up. In front of her stands Kari Trestakk in her rattling wooden trestakk, sooty and upright. Two young kitchen workers in white stare at her from the dishwashing station.
illustrations.caption: Kjøkkensjefen skrev det på vaktlista uten å se opp.
illustrations.alt: I et stort kjøkken med stålbenker skriver kjøkkensjefen på ei liste uten å se opp. Foran henne står Kari i en skranglete trestakk av bord og filler.

illustrations.anchor: «Tror du jeg vil ha vann som du har båret?»
illustrations.prompt: At the top of a steep back staircase in the castle, the Prince has torn open his door and empties a tall silver jug of water over Kari Trestakk, who stands on the top step in her wooden trestakk with her eyes shut, water streaming down her sooty face. His handsome face is twisted with disgust. Plain white walls and grey Sunday-morning light from a small window.
illustrations.caption: «Tror du jeg vil ha vann som du har båret?»
illustrations.alt: Øverst i trappa tømmer prinsen en høy sølvmugge med vann over Kari Trestakk. Hun står stille med lukkede øyne mens vannet renner.

illustrations.anchor: Mannen gikk inn i berget og kom ut igjen med en kjole som skinte
illustrations.prompt: At the foot of the Cliff, where a narrow crack stands open in the rock, the Man from the Rock holds out a simply cut gown of shining copper and a pair of long copper gloves. Kari Trestakk, still damp and sooty in her wooden trestakk, stares at the gown with her hands pressed to her mouth. Behind them stands a saddled chestnut horse, and the heather bends in the wind.
illustrations.caption: Han kom ut igjen med en kjole som skinte som kobberskogen.
illustrations.alt: Under bergveggen holder mannen i berget fram en skinnende kobberkjole og et par lange hansker. Kari står i trestakken og ser forundret på den. Bak dem står en salet hest.

illustrations.anchor: Og det ble lyst foran henne og mørkt bak, og da prinsen kunne se igjen
illustrations.prompt: Outside the Stone Church after the service, a dazzling white light blazes in front of Kari in the Copper Dress as she rides off on her chestnut horse, and a wall of darkness has fallen behind her. The Prince stands blinking with one of her copper gloves in his hand, and six churchgoers hold up their phones to film her, the screens showing only white glare.
illustrations.caption: Det ble lyst foran henne og mørkt bak, og så var hun borte.
illustrations.alt: Utenfor steinkirka rir Kari bort i kobberkjolen. Foran henne er det et blendende lys og bak henne mørkt. Prinsen står med hansken hennes, og kirkefolk filmer med mobilen.

illustrations.anchor: Kari ga seg ikke.
illustrations.prompt: Seen from the bottom of the back staircase, where two young kitchen workers in white peek round the corner, trying not to laugh: at the top of the stairs, the Prince snatches a white towel from Kari Trestakk and flings it straight into her sooty face. She stands frozen on the landing in her wooden trestakk, and his door stands open behind him.
illustrations.caption: Han rev til seg håndkleet og kastet det rett i ansiktet på henne.
illustrations.alt: Øverst i trappa kaster prinsen et hvitt håndkle rett i ansiktet på Kari Trestakk. Nede i trappa titter to kjøkkenansatte fram og prøver å ikke le.

illustrations.anchor: «Fra Håndkleland», sa Kari, og i det samme mistet hun ridepisken.
illustrations.prompt: On the gravel outside the Stone Church, Kari in the Silver Dress sits high on a dapple-grey horse with a silver-embroidered saddlecloth and a silver bit, looking down with a small smile. Her silver-handled riding whip has just fallen to the ground, and the Prince bends down eagerly to pick it up. Seven churchgoers in Sunday coats watch from the church door.
illustrations.caption: «Fra Håndkleland», sa Kari, og i det samme mistet hun ridepisken.
illustrations.alt: Utenfor steinkirka sitter Kari i sølvkjolen på en apalgrå hest. Hun har mistet ridepisken, og prinsen bøyer seg for å ta den opp.

illustrations.anchor: Da hun kom til kirka, sto både presten og menigheten ute på bakken
illustrations.prompt: On the hill outside the Stone Church, the priest in a white surplice and eighteen churchgoers in coats stand waiting, many holding up their phones, as Kari in the Gold Dress rides up on a cream-coloured horse with a gold-embroidered saddlecloth and a golden bit, glittering like ice in the sun. The Prince runs down the gravel path towards her.
illustrations.caption: Både presten og menigheten sto ute på bakken og ventet på henne.
illustrations.alt: Presten og menigheten står utenfor steinkirka og venter, mange med mobilen oppe. Kari kommer ridende i en glitrende gullkjole, og prinsen løper mot henne.

illustrations.anchor: Men han hadde en plan.
illustrations.prompt: In the stone porch of the Stone Church, a thick black pool of tar covers the floor. Kari in the Gold Dress has just leapt clean across it and lands on the steps outside, one foot in a white stocking, while one small gold shoe stays stuck fast in the tar behind her. Inside the church door, the Prince pushes through the crowd, too late.
illustrations.caption: Hun satte foten midt i tjæra og hoppet over, og den ene gullskoen ble sittende fast.
illustrations.alt: Kari hopper over en dam av svart tjære i våpenhuset. Den ene gullskoen sitter fast i tjæra bak henne, og inne i kirka trenger prinsen seg fram gjennom folk.

illustrations.anchor: «Et stykke av hæl og et stykke av tå, Kari Trestakks sko er full av blod!»
illustrations.prompt: On a country road lined with yellowing birches, an open carriage drawn by two white horses rolls towards the church, with a coachman in grey on the box. In it sit the Prince, stiff and glum in a dark-blue gala uniform with gold braid, the Stepsister in a frothy white wedding dress and veil, smirking, and the Stepmother in grey silk, smiling at everyone. In a birch by the road, a little brown bird sings down at them with its beak wide open.
illustrations.caption: En liten fugl satt i et tre ved veien og sang.
illustrations.alt: Prinsen, stesøstera i brudekjole og stemora kjører i åpen vogn mot kirka. I et bjørketre ved veien sitter en liten fugl og synger.

illustrations.anchor: Kari tok skoen og satte foten i den, lett som ingenting.
illustrations.prompt: In the big, plain hall of the castle's service wing, Kari in the Gold Dress stands on the stone floor, shining, with the boards and rags of her trestakk in a heap at her feet and a gold shoe on each foot. The Prince, in his dark-blue gala uniform, stares at her. Beside him the Stepsister, in her white wedding dress, gapes, and the Stepmother has gone as white as the wall. Twelve kitchen workers and maids stand silent along the walls.
illustrations.caption: Der sto hun i gullkjolen, så det lyste av henne.
illustrations.alt: Kari står i en skinnende gullkjole med restene av trestakken i en haug ved føttene. Prinsen stirrer, stesøstera gaper, og stemora er blitt hvit som veggen.

illustrations.anchor: Kari så lenge på ham.
illustrations.prompt: In the quiet hall of the service wing, Kari in the Gold Dress has stepped up to the Prince, who stands stiff and ashamed in his dark-blue gala uniform, and she puts her arms around his waist and kisses him. He looks utterly astonished. Behind them, three kitchen workers in white break into smiles, and soft light falls through tall windows onto the stone floor.
illustrations.caption: Så var det hun som tok ham rundt livet og kysset ham.
illustrations.alt: Kari i gullkjolen tar prinsen rundt livet og kysser ham. Han ser helt forbløffet ut, og tre kjøkkenansatte bak dem smiler.
